messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — Citrine renewal needs final signoff. Procurement is asking for evidence of onboarding acceptance (SSO + first-week NPS) before they’ll issue the PO. They also swapped the paying entity to Citrine Global. Targeting PO by 2026-04-10. cc @dan_sales @emily_revenueops :eyes:
dan_sales: Got it. What are seats / ARR? Any pricing change requested?
maria_cs: 18 seats, current ARR $72k. Customer asked for a 9mo term instead of 12mo; we prefer 12mo. Propose 11% discount on 12mo + 1 training credit, or 7% on 9mo. Leaning to push for 12mo to stabilize revenue.
emily_revenueops: Need vendor code + billing entity tax ID to generate PO. Also confirm billing contact and email. I can draft a conditional PO if legal needs amendment.
maria_cs: Entity name: Citrine Global Ltd (GB), VAT: GB987654321. Billing contact: payments@citrine.ai. Onboarding acceptance evidence (signed sign-off + first-week NPS screenshot) is at: https://redwood.internal.docs/citrine/onboard-acceptance (shared doc).
ashley_legal: Flag: they requested customer-managed KMS and a data residency note in SOW. That’s a contract change — need to verify signatory authority on the new entity before sending DocuSign. Who will sign for Citrine Global?
maria_cs: CFO (lara.cox@citrine.ai) will sign for Global according to procurement email. I'll ask them for a signed authority letter. For KMS — they want CMK; we need to confirm deployment path (Dedicated vs Private). @tom_support can you confirm feasibility and ETA?
tom_support: We can support CMK, but only for Dedicated or Private deployments. Hosted would require org-level integration and ~2–3 weeks lead time to enable. If they want CMK before PO we should set expectation on schedule. :+1:
ashley_legal: If CMK is required, contract must include key-handling responsibilities and migration clauses. I’ll draft a short amendment and review before DocuSign — please do not send out the contract until I sign off.
maria_cs: Understood — holding DocuSign. For procurement, we can accept a conditional PO that references the amendment. emily_revenueops, can you upload a PO template with a conditional clause?
emily_revenueops: Uploaded PO template v3 with this conditional language: `PO is subject to execution of SOW amendment addressing KMS and signatory authority.` Link: https://shared.internal/po_templates/citrine-po-v3.pdf
maria_cs: Perfect. I’ll request the authority letter and onboarding artifacts from the customer today. If we don't have signed items by 2026-04-10, I’m marking this renewal as medium-high risk. :warning:
deploybot: Note: Contract templates v3 deployed to /legal/templates at 1718374700
dan_sales: I’ll loop in the AE and the CFO to push for the sign-off. Any other blockers we should surface to AM/RevOps?
maria_cs: Only outstanding items: authority letter, signed conditional PO, and a KMS deployment decision. Will update thread when authority letter arrives. Thanks all. :pray:
